$comment: Hello World's default tool selection (loaded with the toolsConfig option). Users can change it in Settings > Tools; 'Download ai-tools.json' there writes this format.

find_text.description: Find every place a word or phrase occurs in the document.

get_selection.description: The text the user has selected, and where the cursor is.

insert_text.description: Insert text at the cursor, or at the start or end.

replace_text.description: Replace a word or phrase everywhere in the document.

set_editor_settings.description: Change the editor's font size and line wrapping.

replace_document.description: Replace the whole document with new text.
